dict.string: Waxwing scans for and connects to nearby Waxwing mesh nodes over Bluetooth LE.
Waxwing uses Bluetooth to communicate with nearby mesh nodes.
Waxwing uses the camera to capture photos for uploading to your Waxwing mesh node.
Your location is used to geo-tag images you share with the Waxwing mesh.
Waxwing needs photo library access to select photos for upload.
Waxwing saves processed images to your photo library.
